mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body helped me picture how the diaphragm separates them while routes still cross between regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Some fittings felt predictable, especially placing the eye and ears in the head, though they made the model complete.

surprise.text: The joined regions made it clearer that the food pipe, nerves and blood vessels cross between chest and abdomen by their own routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the placements had named spaces or visible connections. The last two combinations were also the only offered actions.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems respond together. The final view made those connections interesting, although some fitting steps were predictable.
